plan.beta_rule: partition m/(d-1), unchanged by excluding 16 eigenvalues from fitting
plan.covariance_method: CPU float64 column-chunk Gram minus d*outer(row_means,row_means), reuse principal submatrices
plan.quantile_rank_rule: Original ascending index j uses p=(j+0.5)/m; top16 removed without rescaling remaining CDF
plan.fit_scale_rule: median of observed eigenvalue / unit-variance MP quantile at each retained original probability
plan.mp_quantile_method: theta grid 65537 points, cumulative trapezoid of (2/pi)*sin(theta)^2/(1+beta-2*sqrt(beta)*cos(theta)), normalize numerical mass, monotone interpolation
plan.negative_eigenvalue_tolerance: 100*eps_float64*max(m,d)*max(abs(raw_eigenvalues)); retain raw negatives in output; clip only tolerated negatives for fit
plan.no_fit_fallback: No replacement by zero, h^2/12, or legacy c_mp; report null and explicit reason
plan.subspace_rule: Right singular vectors in original feature coordinates, only eigenvalues above numerical tolerance; keep all 16 attack targets unchanged
plan.reporting: All partitions, raw spectra, fitted scales/edges, fit-window sensitivity, row counts, public radius statistics, runtime and process memory
plan.interpretation: Fit availability is not model acceptance. MP resemblance does not establish iid noise, recoverable image count, or defense strength. No automatic downstream experiment.
